protocol.unit: Paired 30% minus 20% outcome; inference resamples supplier means, not repeated cases.
protocol.financial_groups: Credit index >=300 existing heuristic; all-46 median credit=224.0; median equity=33.95.
protocol.interpretation: Exploratory association in synthetic outcomes, not observed supplier willingness or causation. Hidden supplier economics were generated independently of profile risk.
protocol.bootstrap: 4000 supplier resamples, seed 601, percentile 95% intervals, no generalization guarantee.
protocol.correlation: Spearman with ties; 1999 two-sided permutations; unadjusted permutation p-values and Benjamini-Hochberg q-values across all 18 exploratory correlations.
protocol.training: No training, no retuning, no online sessions. Existing 19 suppliers only.

document_evidence.scope: All 46 dossiers, documents dated through 2026-09-30. Exact phrase extraction from the fictional challenge package, not independent market observations.
